titleEn: Minimum Operations to Form Subsequence With Target Sum
title: 使子序列的和等于目标的最少操作次数
summary: 数组元素均为二的幂，每次可把一个数拆成两个相等的一半，求能选出和为 target 的子序列所需最少拆分数。
insight: 按二进制位从低到高满足 target。当前位需要但无可用幂时，从最近的更高位取一个并逐层拆下来，距离就是新增操作数；当前位多余的两个幂可免费视为一个更高位容量。
pitfalls: 数组总和小于 target 时直接无解
必须从最近有库存的高位向下拆
每次拆分只下降一个二进制位
处理完当前位后合并多余成对库存

solutions.title: 位计数贪心拆最近高位
solutions.idea: 从低位开始保证已处理 target 位精确满足。
steps: 统计每个二次幂位的数量与总和
总和小于 target 返回负一
若 target 需要该位且 count[bit] 为零，向上找最近库存
逐层拆分并累计操作数
把剩余当前位每两个合并计入下一位

code.java: class Solution { public int minOperations(List<Integer> nums,int target){long total=0;long[] count=new long[32];for(int value:nums){total+=value;count[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(value)]++;}if(total<target)return -1;int operations=0;for(int bit=0;bit<=30;bit++){if(((target>>bit)&1)==1){if(count[bit]==0){int higher=bit+1;while(higher<32&&count[higher]==0)higher++;while(higher>bit){count[higher]--;count[higher-1]+=2;higher--;operations++;}}count[bit]--;}count[bit+1]+=count[bit]/2;}return operations;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minOperations(nums:List<Int>,target:Int):Int{var total=0L;val count=LongArray(32);for(value in nums){total+=value;count[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(value)]++};if(total<target)return -1;var operations=0;for(bit in 0..30){if((target shr bit and 1)==1){if(count[bit]==0L){var higher=bit+1;while(higher<32&&count[higher]==0L)higher++;while(higher>bit){count[higher]--;count[higher-1]+=2;higher--;operations++}};count[bit]--};count[bit+1]+=count[bit]/2};return operations} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minOperations(vector<int>& nums,int target){long long total=0,count[32]={};for(int value:nums){total+=value;++count[__builtin_ctz(value)];}if(total<target)return -1;int operations=0;for(int bit=0;bit<=30;++bit){if(target>>bit&1){if(!count[bit]){int higher=bit+1;while(higher<32&&!count[higher])++higher;while(higher>bit){--count[higher];count[higher-1]+=2;--higher;++operations;}}--count[bit];}count[bit+1]+=count[bit]/2;}return operations;} };
